verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch could plausibly publish an interactive reference for its own platform API, so the axis applies, but the pack shows none: every OpenAPI/Swagger probe path returns 404 (hoppscotch-probe-2). The Embed feature, which lets users publish interactive request widgets for their own APIs, is an adjacent capability and earns no credit here; llms.txt, the CLI and the MCP server are separate stories.
